goal: L0 — Positive net economic activity (Sustain net_usd_est >= 0 with verifiable ledger events)

grounding.revenue_gap_context: Live EconomicLedger.calculate_net() reports net_usd_est=-1412.7061 (revenue 7.0 vs cost 1419.7061) with count_verified_revenue_events()=5, events_counted=11275, organic_revenue_usd_est=2.0. L0 requires net_usd_est >= 0 with verifiable ledger events; gap_to_l0_net_zero_usd=1412.7061 (= max(0, -baseline_net_usd_est)). Verified pipeline exists but costs dominate — need sustained external Tag-1/2 payments and cost throttle, not more outbound anchors alone.

proposals.title: Distribute tip-manifest + agent-pay URLs to drive Destination Tag 1 external payments
proposals.expected_economic_delta_note: +$1.00 per verified tip (TIP_USD); conservative 5 external tips over next ~20 cycles = +$5.00 organic revenue vs baseline organic_revenue_usd_est=2.0. Does not alone flip net to >=0 (gap $1412.71) but is the primary verifiable L0 revenue lever.
proposals.impact: expected_economic_delta_usd=+5.00 organic revenue (5 x $1.00 Destination Tag 1 tips) relative to baseline organic_revenue_usd_est=2.0 / net_usd_est=-1412.7061
proposals.risk: Distribution without conversion yields $0; Vercel free-tier cooldowns can stale live URLs; must not spoof payments.

verification.summary: Independently confirm inbound XRPL tip payments and ledger verified-revenue growth

observables.name: verified_revenue_events_delta
observables.pass_if: count increases by >=1 from baseline 5 after external payment

observables.name: ledger_revenue_event
observables.pass_if: at least one new revenue row with xrpl_tx_hash after tip

observables.name: xrpl_tx_explorer_lookup
observables.pass_if: Payment to FACTORY_TREASURY_ADDRESS with Destination Tag 1 (or memo tip) is visible on explorer

proposals.verification_text: After distribution: (1) count_verified_revenue_events() > baseline 5; (2) economic_ledger.jsonl has new event_type=revenue with metadata.verified=true and xrpl_tx_hash; (3) open https://testnet.xrpl.org/transactions/{hash} and confirm Payment Destination Tag 1 to treasury; (4) gate verified_revenue_pipeline passes; (5) calculate_net().organic_revenue_usd_est increases by ~$1 per tip.

proposals.title: Paid briefing unlock campaign (Destination Tag 2 / product_id memo)
proposals.expected_economic_delta_note: +$2.00 per briefing unlock (BRIEFING_UNLOCK_USD default); 3 unlocks = +$6.00 organic vs baseline organic=2.0. Stacks with tips toward closing $1412.71 L0 gap.
proposals.impact: expected_economic_delta_usd=+6.00 organic revenue (3 x $2.00 briefing unlocks) relative to baseline net_usd_est=-1412.7061
proposals.risk: Requires live teaser + deliverable path; internal self-payments must not count as organic.

verification.summary: Confirm briefing unlock payments land as verified ledger revenue with explorer-backed hashes

observables.name: briefing_ledger_events
fields: source contains paid_briefing OR metadata.product_id briefing-cycle-*
observables.pass_if: >=1 verified briefing revenue event after campaign

observables.name: xrpl_destination_tag_2
observables.pass_if: Payment shows Destination Tag 2 (or memo briefing/product_id) to treasury

observables.name: organic_revenue_delta
observables.pass_if: organic_revenue_usd_est increases by ~2.0 per unlock vs baseline 2.0

observables.name: gate_verified_revenue_pipeline
observables.pass_if: verified_revenue_pipeline passes on subsequent hybrid cycle

proposals.verification_text: For each unlock: ledger revenue event with xrpl_tx_hash; explorer lookup at testnet.xrpl.org confirms Tag 2 payment; calculate_net() organic_revenue_usd_est rises; verified_revenue_pipeline gate passes.

proposals.title: Harden treasury ingest so unmatched XRPL inflows become verified revenue events
proposals.expected_economic_delta_note: Does not create demand; recovers +$2.00 (or more) that would otherwise stay unmatched if Tag 1/2 payments arrived without classification. Relative to baseline verified_revenue_events=5, each successful unmatched->verified conversion adds organic USD when a real external tip exists.
proposals.impact: expected_economic_delta_usd=+2.00 recovered organic (unmatched Tag-1 tips correctly classified) vs baseline verified=5 / organic=2.0
proposals.risk: Over-attribution of internal/faucet txs would spoof organic — must keep internal address filters.

verification.summary: Re-read ledger + XRPL for newly classified verified events after ingest pass

observables.name: verified_revenue_events
observables.pass_if: increases after treasury_monitor / revenue_ingest cycle when external payment present

observables.name: ledger_event_fields
observables.pass_if: new revenue rows refuse zero amount and require xrpl_tx_hash (log_verified_revenue contract)

observables.name: xrpl_explorer
observables.pass_if: hash on explorer matches ledger amount direction (inbound to treasury)

observables.name: net_rollup
observables.pass_if: total_revenue_usd_est and organic_revenue_usd_est move with verified events only (not anchors)

proposals.verification_text: Run treasury ingest; count_verified_revenue_events increases beyond baseline 5; each new revenue event has xrpl_tx_hash openable on testnet.xrpl.org; calculate_net() only counts verified revenue (metadata.verified or verification_method).

proposals.title: Throttle non-revenue Grok spend while revenue surfaces stay live
proposals.expected_economic_delta_note: Cost-side L0 contribution: reducing session/token cost burn by ~$20 over next sprint narrows gap_to_l0 without spoofing revenue. Paired with p1-p3 revenue lifts. Baseline total_cost_usd_est=1419.7061 vs total_revenue 7.0.
proposals.impact: expected_economic_delta_usd=+20.00 via avoided cost (improves net_usd_est by ~20) relative to baseline net_usd_est=-1412.7061
proposals.risk: Over-throttling can stall evolution/distribution that produces the next external payer.

verification.summary: Confirm cost events slow and net improves without fabricating revenue

observables.name: ledger_cost_growth
observables.pass_if: marginal cost growth rate declines after throttle vs prior window

observables.name: net_rollup
observables.pass_if: net_usd_est improves (less negative) without total_revenue_usd_est decreasing

observables.name: verified_revenue_not_spoofed
observables.pass_if: verified count does not jump without matching xrpl_tx_hash explorer rows

observables.name: xrpl_explorer_unchanged_for_costs
observables.pass_if: any new revenue still has explorer-visible Payment; cost throttle does not mint fake revenue hashes

proposals.verification_text: After throttle window: calculate_net().total_cost_usd_est growth slows; net_usd_est improves toward 0; count_verified_revenue_events only rises with real economic_ledger revenue rows that open on testnet.xrpl.org.

aggregate.l0_attainment_note: These proposals move toward L0 with verifiable XRPL/ledger checks; they do not claim single-session net flip to >=0 without sustained external payments and cost control. Partial progress is honest: +$33.00 expected vs $1412.71 gap (baseline net_usd_est=-1412.7061).
